experiment_data.hypothesis: Cutoff at 15K steps tests the minimum duration of auxiliary gradient flow needed for collision avoidance. If CAR degrades significantly vs cutoff@25K and cutoff@35K, the encoder requires sustained gradient flow well beyond 15K steps. Combined with 25K/35K/45K/reverse, maps the dose-response curve of gradient flow duration.
